sum: Serve Robotics Inc. designs, develops, and operates low-emission robots that serve people in public and commercial spaces for food delivery activity in the United States. It builds self-driving delivery robots. Serve Robotics Inc. was founded in 2017 and is headquartered in Redwood City, California.
ceo: Dr. Ali  Kashani Ph.D. (Co-Founder, Chairman, CEO, Treasurer & Secretary)
